encounters.title: Broken Causeway
encounters.stakes: A stone bridge over a shard-chasm has collapsed to a single beam. Advance the Journey Clock by 1 if you take the long way, or assign dice for a Medium crossing: failure drops one character for 1 hit and still advances the clock.

encounters.title: Ash Wind Front
encounters.stakes: A wall of volcanic grit blinds the road. Mark +1 Journey Clock. Camp now (see Campfire Counsel) or push on: Hard Hard to keep the map accurate; failure means you become Lost (resolve one extra encounter before the Gate).

encounters.title: Refugee Column
encounters.stakes: Starving surface folk block the trail, begging for crystal dust. Give supplies (lose 1 energy from the party) or refuse and gain a Debt mark from their guild patrons later. Clock does not advance if you share.

encounters.title: Toll of the Free Companies
encounters.stakes: Mercenaries claim this ridge. Pay a Favor owed or fight a short skirmish; either way the clock advances unless you sneak (Medium) past without payment.

encounters.title: Flooded Quarry Road
encounters.stakes: Meltwater from shard-heat floods the path. Detour (+2 Journey Clock) or ford: each character risks 1 hit on a failed Easy swim/climb.

encounters.title: False Milestone
encounters.stakes: Someone rotated the waystones. Easy Insight/WIS-style check (assign Easy die) to notice; failure advances clock by 2 as you loop.

encounters.title: Night Herd
encounters.stakes: Crystal-maddened cattle stampede at dusk. Scatter (all Move Easy) or hold the line (one Warrior Medium): failure deals 1 hit to a random character; success yields rations and clock stays.

encounters.title: Signal Fires on the Ridge
encounters.stakes: Three fires form a triangle---ambush code. Advance clock by camping cold (+1 Stress if no fire) or light a counter-signal (Medium) to negotiate passage.

encounters.title: Collapsed Mining Sled
encounters.stakes: Abandoned sled of raw glass. Salvage (gain 1 energy crystal, +1 Resonance Stress) or leave it; scavengers later become a Debt encounter if you take it.

encounters.title: Border Plague Banner
encounters.stakes: A kingdom quarantine blocks the high road. Bribe (pay Favor), detour (+2 clock), or forge papers (Hard Hard on Rogue/Mage).

encounters.title: Singing Rails
encounters.stakes: Old ore rails hum with shard current. Traveling them cuts 1 clock but marks +1 Resonance Stress per character.

encounters.title: Guide Who Lies
encounters.stakes: A local guide offers a shortcut. Trust them (-1 clock, then roll a Gate Omen early) or dismiss them (clock +1, safe road).

encounters.title: River Ferry Strike
encounters.stakes: Ferrymen refuse coin, demand Aether-Glass. Pay (Stress +1) or build a raft (party assigns 3 Easy successes) while clock +1.

encounters.title: Mirror Mirage
encounters.stakes: Heat haze shows a second party walking your road. Ignore it (clock +1 from delay) or follow (roll Omens as if at a Gate).

encounters.title: Burned Waystation
encounters.stakes: Only charred beams remain. Search (Medium) for a map fragment that reduces next clock tick by 1; failure finds corpses and +1 Stress.

encounters.title: Knight-Errant's Challenge
encounters.stakes: A duel for right of way. One character faces a Medium contest; win and clock does not advance; lose and take 1 hit, clock +1.

encounters.title: Sinking Cart Road
encounters.stakes: Mud eats wheels. Abandon gear (lose a tool) to keep clock, or labor (Hard Hard, all help with Aids) to haul through.

encounters.title: Eclipse Noon
encounters.stakes: Shard-dust darkens the sun for an hour. No navigation: auto clock +1, and roll Resonance Stress encounter next.

encounters.title: Caged Prophet
encounters.stakes: A cage hangs over the road; the prisoner knows a shorter path. Free them (Favor to outlaws, -1 clock) or leave them (clock +0, later Debt from their kin).

encounters.title: Last League Markers
encounters.stakes: You near your destination. Clear the final league Easy or the clock fills: arrive Exhausted (start next combat with -1 party die).

encounters.title: Vein Hum
encounters.stakes: The ground vibrates with crystal song. Mark +1 Resonance Stress. Medium to tune it out; failure: one character gains a minor mutation (cosmetic, -1 CHA checks).

encounters.title: Static Kiss
encounters.stakes: Sparks leap to metal. Anyone in mail takes 1 hit unless they Guard (Easy) or strip armor for the day.

encounters.title: Glass Hunger
encounters.stakes: A party member craves raw shard. Spend 1 energy crystal to calm them or mark +2 Stress and they act first in the next fight recklessly.

encounters.title: Echo of Aethelgard
encounters.stakes: A dead language floods a mage's dreams. Gain a free Lore fact; mark +1 Stress. Refuse the vision: Hard Hard or wake with 1 hit.

encounters.title: Bleeding Focus
encounters.stakes: Aether-Glass tools weep red light. Destroy a crystal focus (-1 Stress) or keep it (+1 Stress, +1 hit on next Arc Bolt).

encounters.title: Chorus of Flies
encounters.stakes: Insects swarm toward the most resonant character. Easy to endure; failure: that character cannot Aid until after a Campfire.

encounters.title: Memory Theft
encounters.stakes: Stress flares: cross out one Scout or Lore result you are holding; if you hold none, mark +1 Journey Clock. Recover with Campfire Counsel Lore.

encounters.title: Crystal Rash
encounters.stakes: Skin facets appear overnight. +1 Stress. Medium CON-style endurance or gain Disfigured (foes target you first once per fight).

encounters.title: Sympathetic Pain
encounters.stakes: When any ally takes a hit next combat, you take 1 too until Stress is reduced at camp.

encounters.title: Oracle Bleed
encounters.stakes: Nosebleeds during planning. Seer/Mage may force a reroll on one Journey roll now; mark +2 Stress.

encounters.title: Hollow Appetite
encounters.stakes: Food tastes like ash. Rations heal nothing until Stress drops; clock still advances if you delay to forage.

encounters.title: Shard-Twin
encounters.stakes: You glimpse a crystal double of the party. Strike it (Medium) to -1 Stress or flee (+1 Stress, +1 clock).

encounters.title: Tuning Fork Bones
encounters.stakes: Joints ache near veins. -1 die face on all physical Easy actions until camp.

encounters.title: Gift of Sparks
encounters.stakes: Uncontrolled lightning from fingertips. Free 1 hit to a foe in a future fight, then +1 Stress now.

encounters.title: Silent Hour
encounters.stakes: All sound dies for an hour. Communication only by gesture: next negotiation is Hard Hard; Stress +1.

encounters.title: Geode Heartbeat
encounters.stakes: A character's pulse syncs to the Shard. +1 Stress; they may ignore one Guard-break once.

encounters.title: Dust Communion
encounters.stakes: Inhale glittered air. Heal 1 hit and +2 Stress, or hold breath (Easy) with no effect.

encounters.title: Name in the Glass
encounters.stakes: Crystal shows a loved one's face asking you to dig deeper. Resist (Medium) or mark a personal Quest Debt and +1 Stress.

encounters.title: Overcharge Cache
encounters.stakes: Found battery-crystals. Take them (+1 party energy, +1 Stress each) or smash them (-1 Stress, noise attracts Journey encounter).

encounters.title: Resonance Break
encounters.stakes: Stress track fills. Roll on the Corruption Mutations table now, or burn 2 Favor marks to vent safely; if you can do neither, start the next delve unable to Guard in its first round.

encounters.title: Guild Ledger Nail
encounters.stakes: A nail-post lists your party names. Tear it down (angers guild: +2 Debt) or leave it (collectors arrive next town).

encounters.title: Interest in Flesh
encounters.stakes: A broker offers to clear 1 Debt for a finger's worth of crystal fused to skin (+1 Stress).

encounters.title: Witness for the Crown
encounters.stakes: Crown agents demand testimony against a Mining Guild. Testify (Favor with Crown, Debt with Guild) or refuse (Debt with Crown).

encounters.title: Hostage Letter
encounters.stakes: Proof a relative is held. Pay 2 crystal/energy or accept a timed Quest: fail and gain Desperate Debt (all Favor costs double).

encounters.title: Forgiven---For Now
encounters.stakes: A patron clears 1 Debt if you carry a sealed box to a Gate. Do not open it (Hard Hard temptation); opening rolls an Omen immediately.

encounters.title: Street Tithe
encounters.stakes: Urchins working for Debtknife gangs demand coin. Pay (clear local heat) or chase them (Medium; failure +1 Debt rumor).

encounters.title: Contract Rewrite
encounters.stakes: A scribe can alter your obligation. Hard Hard CHA/INT; success converts Debt to Favor owed by them; failure doubles Debt.

encounters.title: Blood Co-Signer
encounters.stakes: An ally must co-sign your Debt. They mark +1 personal Debt; party Debt -1.

encounters.title: Smuggler's Credit
encounters.stakes: Buy gear on credit. Gain an item; +1 Debt. Default later and lose the item plus a Favor.

encounters.title: Church of Clearance
encounters.stakes: A cult clears Debt through confession---and public branding. Clear 1 Debt; gain Branded (surface towns hostile once).

encounters.title: Rival Party's Marker
encounters.stakes: Another delve team holds your Favor chit. Trade a future aid promise or steal it (Rogue Medium; failure: combat stub).

encounters.title: Assessor's Scale
encounters.stakes: Officials weigh your crystal. Undervalued unless Mage Medium to argue purity; failure: taxed (+1 Debt equivalent).

encounters.title: Inheritance Trap
encounters.stakes: A will names you heirs to a bankrupt claim. Accept (+2 Debt, claim rights) or renounce (safe, lose lore hook).

encounters.title: Favor Called In
encounters.stakes: Someone you owe demands escort through a Journey leg. Complete it (-1 Debt) or refuse (+2 Debt, enemy for life).

encounters.title: Blackmail Plate
encounters.stakes: Etched plate shows your crime. Destroy (Medium stealth) or buy silence (1 Favor). Leave it: next roll on this table is forced.

encounters.title: Debtors' Arena
encounters.stakes: Fight as entertainment to erase 1 Debt. One character: win a Medium duel stub; lose and Debt remains +1 Stress.

encounters.title: Ledger Fire
encounters.stakes: Chance to burn guild records. Hard Hard infiltration; success clears 2 Debt; failure: Wanted (all towns +1 Debt).

encounters.title: Mercy of the Countess
encounters.stakes: A noble offers Favor if you ruin a guild rival socially. Succeed Medium intrigue; fail and both factions Debt you.

encounters.title: Child of the Bond
encounters.stakes: A bonded child seeks freedom. Free them (Favor with outcasts, Debt with owners) or return them (-1 Debt, +1 Stress).

encounters.title: Zero Balance Knife
encounters.stakes: Assassin offers to kill your creditor. Accept (Debt clears, gain Blood Favor owed to killer) or refuse (creditor warned, +1 Debt).

encounters.title: Falling Sun Echo
encounters.stakes: At the Gate, daylight burns underground for a minute. Next delve: all Strikes +1 hit but Stress +1 when you exit.

encounters.title: Three Blind Birds
encounters.stakes: Dead birds fall from the Gate arch. Omens say: no flying/falling shortcuts; Move between vertical zones costs Medium.

encounters.title: Mirror Gate
encounters.stakes: The Gate shows your party exiting already bloody. Heed it: start with Guard on all, or ignore and first combat foes Strike first.

encounters.title: Salt Rain
encounters.stakes: White grit falls upward into the Gate. Water rations spoil; next Campfire Heal is Hard Hard.

encounters.title: Counting Shadows
encounters.stakes: Shadows don't match bodies. One shadow too many: a stalker joins the delve (extra foe) unless you leave an offering (1 energy).

encounters.title: Gate That Breathes
encounters.stakes: Air pulls inward. First zone: all Easy actions need face 2+. Close visors (no scent clues).

encounters.title: Name Spoken Backward
encounters.stakes: Someone says a companion's name reversed. That character is Marked: hazards target them until a Campfire Lore clears it.

encounters.title: Glass Teeth
encounters.stakes: Gate rim grows teeth. Entering deals 1 hit unless Guard Easy. Teeth keep a trophy (item lost) on failure.

encounters.title: Second Threshold
encounters.stakes: Two Gates overlap. Choose left (Journey Clock +0, Stress +1) or right (Clock +1, find a Favor token).

encounters.title: Priestless Blessing
encounters.stakes: A hollow robe bows. Accept a ward (one free Guard this delve) and +1 Stress, or pass by clean.

encounters.title: Red Thread
encounters.stakes: A thread ties two party members. They must share zones this delve or each take 1 hit per separated round.

encounters.title: Silent Market
encounters.stakes: Ghost stalls sell memories. Buy (lose a Motivation detail, gain 1 energy) or smash stalls (Omen becomes hostile: +1 foe).

encounters.title: Clockface Moss
encounters.stakes: Moss grows in clock shapes. Read it (Easy): learn exact Journey ticks remaining; misread (fail): Clock +2.

encounters.title: Child Gatekeeper
encounters.stakes: A mute child holds the key-crystal. Kindness (Aid Medium) opens safely; cruelty opens but +2 Stress.

encounters.title: Inverted Drip
encounters.stakes: Water drips up. Next Resonance encounter is mandatory after first combat.

encounters.title: Banner of the Old World
encounters.stakes: Aethelgard colors flicker. Mage may learn one free class-flavor cantrip once; Party Stress +1.

encounters.title: Door of Knives
encounters.stakes: Entering requires leaving a weapon. Retrieve on exit Easy; failure: weapon is bound to a foe.

encounters.title: Laughing Echo
encounters.stakes: Your voices return wrong. No Aid by speech this delve (Aid still ok by gesture/Easy without voice).

encounters.title: Omen of Plenty
encounters.stakes: Crystal dew coats you. +1 energy each; next Debt collector knows you struck rich (+1 Debt pressure).

encounters.title: Sealed With Lead
encounters.stakes: The Gate is lead-banded. Break seal (Hard Hard) and roll again on Omens, or walk away (Clock +1, delve delayed).

encounters.title: Shared Watch
encounters.stakes: Assign dice: Scout (Easy) keeps night safe; fail and Journey encounter interrupts sleep (no Heal).

encounters.title: Blade and Story
encounters.stakes: Repair (Medium) restores a broken tool; Lore (Easy) reveals a rumor that -1 next Omen severity.

encounters.title: Confession Circle
encounters.stakes: Speak a fear. Clear 1 Stress if honest; gain a Bond (once/fight, Aid that ally without energy).

encounters.title: Ration Argument
encounters.stakes: Split food unfairly. Medium CHA to keep peace; failure: one character refuses Aid tomorrow.

encounters.title: Map by Embers
encounters.stakes: Redraw the route in ash. Success (Easy) -1 Journey Clock; failure smudges map (next travel Lost risk).

encounters.title: Shard Meditation
encounters.stakes: Mage vents Stress into the fire. -1 Stress; on 1 on a spare d6, fire becomes a hazard (1 hit).

encounters.title: Silent Meal
encounters.stakes: No talk---only dice. Each character may Heal (Easy) or Guard-for-dawn (Easy); no Bargain allowed tonight.

encounters.title: Trader at the Edge of Light
encounters.stakes: A night merchant. Bargain (Medium) for supplies; fail and they steal 1 energy.

encounters.title: Dream Delve
encounters.stakes: All dream the same dungeon room. Lore (Medium) to map it; use that map for advantage (one free Easy) next Gate.

encounters.title: Stitch and Swear
encounters.stakes: Heal (Medium) removes 1 hit from one character; swear a Vow (mark Favor to each other).

encounters.title: Burn the Letter
encounters.stakes: Destroy Debt evidence in the fire. Clear 1 Debt; smoke signals attract a Journey encounter at dawn.

encounters.title: Counting Favors
encounters.stakes: Publicly track who owes whom. Rearrange 1 Debt/Favor mark between party and NPCs known so far.

encounters.title: Scarecrow Watch
encounters.stakes: Build a decoy. Scout success: skip next night ambush; failure: waste materials (lose tool).

encounters.title: Bitter Brew
encounters.stakes: Dust Alchemist-style tea. Heal all 1 hit and +1 Stress each, or skip.

encounters.title: Naming the Dead
encounters.stakes: Lore for fallen NPCs. Gain a Favor with their kin faction; Stress -1.

encounters.title: Sparring Embers
encounters.stakes: Two characters practice. Both spend Medium; both gain +1 face once tomorrow, or take 1 hit on failure.

encounters.title: False Dawn Pack-Up
encounters.stakes: Leave early. Clock -1 but no one Heals; or sleep in (Heal allowed, Clock +0).

encounters.title: Omen in the Coals
encounters.stakes: Read fire (Easy WIS). Roll the next Gate Omen now and keep it; on a failure, roll it now but it changes: reroll it at the Gate and apply the second result.

encounters.title: Last Song
encounters.stakes: Anyone sings (Medium CHA). Success: party -1 Stress. Failure: -1 Stress anyway, but the first fight of the next delve adds one Minion of your choice to the monsters.

encounters.title: Scatter the Ashes
encounters.stakes: Break camp clean. Next collectors/trackers need Hard Hard to find your trail; fail to scatter and Debt agents arrive next stop.

flavors.Broken Causeway: A shard-chasm splits the old royal road. Wind moans through crystal teeth below; one beam is all that remains of the bridge the Guild swore would last forever.
flavors.Ash Wind Front: The Ash Frontier exhales. Grit scours paint from shields and turns the sun into a rumor.
flavors.Refugee Column: Families flee a Gate that woke hungry. Their hands are empty except for hope and the Guild brands on their wrists.
flavors.Toll of the Free Companies: Mercenary banners stitch the ridge. Coin or blood---they are not picky, only patient.
flavors.Flooded Quarry Road: Shard-heat melted the snow wrong. Black water fills the quarry cut like a held breath.
flavors.False Milestone: Someone twisted the waystones for a joke or a murder. Moss still grows toward the old true north.
flavors.Night Herd: Cattle with crystal cataracts thunder at dusk, lowing in frequencies that itch the teeth.
flavors.Signal Fires on the Ridge: Three fires make a triangle the Free Companies use for ambush. Your fire would answer---or betray.
flavors.Collapsed Mining Sled: A sled of raw glass lies broken, humming faintly. Scavengers' footprints circle like unfinished prayers.
flavors.Border Plague Banner: Yellow cloth and spears. The quarantine is half medicine, half tax.
flavors.Singing Rails: Abandoned ore rails sing when the Shard pulses. Riding them feels like cheating the clock---and feeding it your nerves.
flavors.Guide Who Lies: A smiling local offers a shortcut through thorn and rumor. Their eyes flick too often toward the Gate.
flavors.River Ferry Strike: Ferrymen want Aether-Glass, not crowns. The river does not care who drowns waiting.
flavors.Mirror Mirage: Heat paints a second party walking your road. They wave with your hands.
flavors.Burned Waystation: Char and bone. Someone fought a Gate omen here and lost the argument.
flavors.Knight-Errant's Challenge: A knight without a kingdom bars the way with courtesy sharp as a spear.
flavors.Sinking Cart Road: Mud eats wheels the way Debt eats years. Something below the road is drinking.
flavors.Eclipse Noon: Shard-dust veils the sun. Birds fall silent; clocks become guesses.
flavors.Caged Prophet: A cage hangs over the road. The prisoner knows a shorter path and a longer curse.
flavors.Last League Markers: Mileposts lean toward your Gate like teeth. The last league always costs more than the map admits.
flavors.Vein Hum: The ground vibrates with crystal song. Even the silent feel lyrics under their skin.
flavors.Static Kiss: Sparks leap to mail and knives. The air tastes of storms that never reach the sky.
flavors.Glass Hunger: A companion stares at raw shard the way the starved stare at bread.
flavors.Echo of Aethelgard: A dead world's tongue floods a sleeper's mouth. Morning tastes like starlight and blood.
flavors.Bleeding Focus: Your Aether tools weep red light. Power wants out---or wants you.
flavors.Chorus of Flies: Insects braid toward the most resonant soul. They know who the Shard has already marked.
flavors.Memory Theft: A map detail evaporates mid-thought. The Star-Grave edits travelers.
flavors.Crystal Rash: Facets bloom under skin overnight---jewelry you cannot pawn.
flavors.Sympathetic Pain: Your nerves braid with your allies'. Their wounds will find you.
flavors.Hollow Appetite: Rations taste of ash and apology. The body refuses comfort while Stress sings.
flavors.Shard-Twin: A crystal double of your party steps from haze---same faces, emptier eyes.
flavors.Tuning Fork Bones: Joints ache in chord with nearby veins. Every Easy motion feels tuned sharp.
flavors.Gift of Sparks: Lightning nests in fingertips. A promise of violence prepaid in Stress.
flavors.Silent Hour: Sound dies. Mouths move; meaning arrives late and wrong.
flavors.Geode Heartbeat: A pulse syncs to the Shard. Guard breaks may miss you---once.
flavors.Dust Communion: Glittered air offers healing like a cult offers wine.
flavors.Name in the Glass: Crystal shows a loved face begging you deeper. The Motivation grows teeth.
flavors.Overcharge Cache: Battery-crystals left by someone who ran. Warm. Waiting.
flavors.Resonance Break: The Stress track overflows. Mutation or ruin---the Shard collects either way.
flavors.Guild Ledger Nail: A nail-post lists your names in wet ink. The Guild wants witnesses.
flavors.Interest in Flesh: A broker smiles with crystal under the skin of their palm. Debt has new interest rates.
flavors.Witness for the Crown: Crown agents want testimony. Guilds want silence. You are the hinge.
flavors.Hostage Letter: Proof of a relative in a cage. Time is a second creditor.
flavors.Forgiven---For Now: A patron clears a mark for one sealed errand. The box hums like an Omen.
flavors.Street Tithe: Urchins with Debtknife tattoos ask politely while counting exits.
flavors.Contract Rewrite: A scribe offers to rewrite fate in triplicate. Ink costs more than blood.
flavors.Blood Co-Signer: The ledger wants a second signature from someone you love.
flavors.Smuggler's Credit: Gear now, ruin later. The interest wears a smile.
flavors.Church of Clearance: A cult clears Debt with confession and a brand that towns remember.
flavors.Rival Party's Marker: Another delve team holds your Favor chit like a knife.
flavors.Assessor's Scale: Officials undervalue crystal unless purity argues back.
flavors.Inheritance Trap: A will names you heirs to a bankrupt claim---rights wrapped in rope.
flavors.Favor Called In: Someone you owe wants escort. Refuse and make an enemy with a long map.
flavors.Blackmail Plate: Your crime etched in plate. Destroy, buy, or let the road force the roll.
flavors.Debtors' Arena: Erase a mark in public bloodsport. The crowd loves a clean ledger.
flavors.Ledger Fire: Guild records burn beautifully. So do the wanted posters that follow.
flavors.Mercy of the Countess: A noble offers Favor for social ruin. Fail and both factions bill you.
flavors.Child of the Bond: A bonded child asks for freedom. Every answer writes Debt somewhere.
flavors.Zero Balance Knife: An assassin offers to kill your creditor. Blood Favor smells like freedom.
flavors.Falling Sun Echo: Daylight burns underground for a minute. The catastrophe still rehearses.
flavors.Three Blind Birds: Dead birds fall from the Gate arch. The omen forbids easy flight between heights.
flavors.Mirror Gate: The Gate shows you exiting already bloody. Premonition or invitation.
flavors.Salt Rain: White grit falls upward. Water dies; Heal becomes a struggle.
flavors.Counting Shadows: One shadow too many. Something joined the party without asking.
flavors.Gate That Breathes: Air pulls inward. Easy becomes slightly less easy at the threshold.
flavors.Name Spoken Backward: A companion's name returns reversed. Hazards learn the Mark.
flavors.Glass Teeth: The rim grows teeth. Entry bites; failure keeps a trophy.
flavors.Second Threshold: Two Gates overlap like a lie. Left costs Stress; right costs Clock.
flavors.Priestless Blessing: A hollow robe bows. Ward for Stress---or walk clean and alone.
flavors.Red Thread: Fate ties two of you. Separate zones bleed.
flavors.Silent Market: Ghost stalls sell memories by the ounce.
flavors.Clockface Moss: Moss grows in clock shapes. Read true or lose hours.
flavors.Child Gatekeeper: A mute child holds the key-crystal. Kindness and cruelty both open doors.
flavors.Inverted Drip: Water drips up. Resonance will follow your first kill.
flavors.Banner of the Old World: Aethelgard colors flicker. Power for Stress.
flavors.Door of Knives: Leave a weapon to enter. Retrieve it---or meet it in a foe's hand.
flavors.Laughing Echo: Voices return wrong. Spoken Aid dies; gestures still live.
flavors.Omen of Plenty: Crystal dew coats you rich. Collectors will smell it.
flavors.Sealed With Lead: Lead bands the Gate. Break and reroll omen---or walk away ticking.
flavors.Shared Watch: Night around a Gate is never empty. Dice decide who sleeps.
flavors.Blade and Story: Steel and rumor share the firelight. Both can be repaired.
flavors.Confession Circle: Fear spoken aloud thins Stress and ties Bonds.
flavors.Map by Embers: Ash is a good ink until the wind edits it.
flavors.Shard Meditation: Vent Stress into flame. Sometimes the flame answers.
flavors.Silent Meal: No talk---only Heal, Guard, and the crackle of distrust.
flavors.Trader at the Edge of Light: A merchant stands where firelight fails. Prices include theft.
flavors.Dream Delve: You all dream one room. Map it before it maps you.
flavors.Stitch and Swear: Needle, vow, Favor between battered hands.
flavors.Burn the Letter: Debt evidence curls to smoke---and signals dawn hunters.
flavors.Counting Favors: Marks rearrange like knives on a table.
flavors.Scarecrow Watch: A decoy wears your fear. Ambush may swallow straw instead.
flavors.Bitter Brew: Alchemist's tea: heal now, Stress later.
flavors.Naming the Dead: Speak the fallen; their kin may answer with Favor.
flavors.Sparring Embers: Practice cuts that tomorrow might need.
flavors.False Dawn Pack-Up: Leave early and lean; or sleep and owe the Clock nothing.
flavors.Omen in the Coals: Fire previews the Gate---or lies for sport.
flavors.Last Song: A hymn thins Stress and thickens the map for listening foes.
flavors.Scatter the Ashes: Clean camps confuse collectors. Dirty ones invite them.
